name: Fortune Fragments
source:
In Fortune Fragments, you run your own shop as a ‘Foreteller' and guide your customers' fates by reading their souls! Sink in the unique blend of Visual Novel roleplaying and hex-tile based rune building set in the bustling modern-fantasy city of Clearcastle.

Having just opened up your Foreteller's shop, you must do your sacred duty and solve the troubles of your wayward customers. Do you console them or give them a rude awakening? Encourage their dreams or make their fears come true? Use their soul stones and your own magical rune fragments to reveal their fate and choose their future actions!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601160/]Steam[/url]]
